name: BenchAudit (benchmark data audit: cross-split duplicates, label conflicts, DTI protein overlap)
url: https://pypi.org/project/benchaudit/ ; paper doi 10.1039/d6sc01799a (Chem Sci 2026, CC BY)
licence_read: code GPL-3 as declared in the PyPI licence text; paper CC BY; weights none; data licence of audited sets not read
verdict: PARTIAL (question 3): its checks (duplicate rows, conflicting labels for one pair, ligand reuse across splits) match the evaluation gap, but nothing was run: the declared dependency list pins torch 2.3 with CUDA wheels and jupyter (multi-GB), inputs are SMILES plus sequences for a train/test split, and our reference is 32 pairs without a split
reopen_condition: Reopen when a contrasting-case comparison needs row-level duplicate/conflict detection beyond fixtures, or when a dependency-free install of the audit functions is shown to work on a small table

name: Bindel and Seifert PDSP Ki vs Guide to Pharmacology series (histamine H1-H4, beta-adrenoceptors, pleiotropic ligands)
licence_read: Mol Pharmacol paper CC BY; JPET papers not open access in Europe PMC; source data stated 'on reasonable request'

reopen_condition: Reopen when a supplementary table with per-ligand pKi, assay system and source is read and contains voltage-gated channel subunits, or a channel paper by the same group appears
